[LOPQ.10.3] **Resource / handle types — out of scope.** Opaque types are values:
copyable, equatable, inert ([LOPQ.5]). A resource or handle type — uncopyable,
lifecycle-bound, must-be-released — is a distinct feature (linear typing) and is
not specified here. Lifecycle-bound resources are held by the adapter behind the
`IDSP` boundary; only value-like results cross into the rule layer. A
content-addressed reference (a hash that is identity) is an opaque **value** and
fits here; an open file or socket handle is a resource and does not.
